Eligibility of Tenderer : Eligibility of Tenderer This invitation for Tender is open to all Eligible Tenderers as mentioned bellow:
(a)1st Class Enlisted Electrical contractor of RAJUK & other Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomas Organization/ having Experience in
similar nature of works.
(b) The Tenderer must posses:
i) Valid Trade License.
ii) VAT.
iii) Income Tax Clearance Certificate (Up to Date).
iv) Valid ABC Electrical Contractory & Supervisory License.
(c) The Tenderer shall have a minimum 07 (seven) years experience in the Similar nature of Electrical works.
(d) The Tenderer shall have successfully completed of 2nos. Internal Electrical works of minimum amount Tk. 1.5 (One core fifty
lac) core single Contract of 15 Storied Building within last 5 (five) years. i.e years counting backward from the date of publication of
IFT in the news paper/Website.
(e)Annual Turnover: Last five years (financial year
2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016) average Annual turn over should be required minimum amount
Tk.02.0 (Two) core.
(f)Liquid Asset: Should be required minimum amount Tk.1.5 (One core fifty lac) .
Furnishing of any false, forged and misleading documents by tenderer shall result in rejection of his/her tender may lead to forfeit
of tender security and Legal action may be taken against Tenderer per PPR & PPA.
